'''Phat Piron''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Brugge Belgian Open Team Event]] on 4 March 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit (Ounee Ta start)]], according to Julien Riviere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1849">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-06-decipher-week-end-brugge-belgium-day-2d1849/ decipher-week-end-brugge-belgium-day-2], DeckTech (Julien "Dark Padawan" Riviere, 6 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-06-decipher-week-end-brugge-belgium-day-2d1849/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
